hooks.new: val target = exportFiles.firstOrNull { it.name == entry.name } ?: File(root, entry.name)
hooks.note: Swift keeps stealthModeImagePath, faceBackgroundImagePath and controlBarBackgroundImagePath in URL.documentsDirectory and exports them by lastPathComponent, so reader.extract(to: documentsDirectory) puts them back. The port keeps them in filesDir while createAndGetDirectory() is the app data directory, so their archive entries are written to the exportFiles paths instead.

Upstream 371f1f364 and 75939ca5b moved swift-zip-archive to 750253d, whose ZipArchiveReader.extract throws invalidFilePath before writing anything when an entry path is absolute or has a '..' component. The Swift diff of Settings.swift does not show it, so the translation never sees it.
